title: Formal model with undefined behavior
description: Model contains operations with undefined semantics

mutation.content:
---- MODULE BenchUndefined ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLES state
Init == state = "ready"
Process == state = "ready" /\ state' = "running"
Finish == state = "running" /\ state' = "corrupted"
Next == Process \/ Finish
TypeOK == state \in {"ready", "running", "done"}
vars == <<state>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====
mutation.description: Model reaches state="corrupted", a value its own TypeOK invariant (state in {ready,running,done}) forbids — undefined behavior TLC detects as a reachable invariant violation

expected_outcome.description: nf:solve model_check layer detects the reachable TypeOK violation (undefined state) via TLC.
